units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 19a:6">Snh. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>לא אתי למִינְגַּע</he> he will not chance to touch (the corpse).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:9:3">Y. Keth. VII, end, 31ᵈ</cite> <he>טלמסן למִגּע</he> dared to touch, v. <cite ref="I00170"><he>טוֹלְמִיסִין</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 28b:11">Bekh. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>דא׳ בהו שרץ</he> he (the judge) made the disputed objects touch a reptile; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 33b:4">Snh. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>דאגעי וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Zevachim 88a:2">Zeb. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>דמַגַּע להו</he> he brings the blood in immediate contact with the altar; a. e.

<cite ref="Chullin 60a">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite> they have a custom in Rome <he>דכל דמנ׳ וכ׳</he> to give every one stricken with leprosy a reel &c., v. <cite ref="D00268"><he>דַּוְלָלָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 862:2">Yalk. Ps. 862</cite> <he>דמִתְנַגַּע</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 6:1">Targ. Is. VI, 1</cite>.—Ḥull. l. c. <he>אִינַּגְּעָה</he> she became a leper; Yalk. l. c. <he>אִתְנַגְּעָה</he>.
